tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: ACADEMe is an AI-powered personalized education platform. The Flutter frontend (mobile/web) communicates with a FastAPI Python backend, which uses Firebase Firestore as its primary database and integrates with Google Gemini 2.0 Flash for AI, Whisper for speech-to-text, and LibreTranslate for multilingual support.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: main.py bootstraps the FastAPI application, configures Firebase credentials (Railway/base64 or local .env), imports all route modules and AI agents, and mounts 12+ routers under /api. It also defines direct API endpoints for multimodal AI processing (text, image, audio, video, document, STT, translation).

tour.title: User Authentication Flow
tour.description: Users register via email OTP verification (SMTP) or Google Sign-In. The auth service generates JWT access tokens (1hr) and refresh tokens (30 days) with bcrypt password hashing. Token refresh and revocation are supported via Firestore blacklist. Role determination checks teacher_profiles and admins collections, defaulting to student.

tour.title: Course Hierarchy & Multilingual Content
tour.description: Content is structured as Course → Topic → Subtopic → Materials/Quizzes. Every entity is created with auto language detection (langdetect) and translated into 7 languages (en, fr, es, de, zh, ar, hi) via LibreTranslate. Responses are served in the user's requested target_language query parameter, falling back to English.

tour.title: Quiz & Assessment System
tour.description: Quizzes can be added to topics or subtopics. Each quiz has multiple questions with 4 options and a correct answer index. Questions are also multilingual. The quiz service supports both admin-managed quizzes and teacher-created exams with quiz and subjective question types.

tour.title: AI Multimodal Agents
tour.description: Seven AI agents handle different media types: text_agent (text Q&A), image_agent (JPEG/PNG/GIF analysis), audio_agent (Whisper transcription + Gemini analysis), video_agent (MP4 analysis via Gemini), document_agent (PDF/DOCX/TXT extraction), stt_agent (pure transcription), and response_translation_agent (translates Gemini responses). All translate content to English before AI processing via LibreTranslate.

tour.title: AI Services (Gemini, Whisper, LibreTranslate)
tour.description: gemini_service.py wraps Google Gemini 2.0 Flash with multimodal support (text, image, video). whisper_service.py uses Hugging Face Inference API with OpenAI Whisper for STT. libretranslate_service.py provides HTTP-based translation. Cloudinary handles media file uploads with CDN delivery.

tour.title: Student Progress Tracking
tour.description: Students log progress (view, quiz_attempt, discussion, reading) per course/topic/subtopic/material/quiz. The progress service aggregates visual data per topic with quiz scores, completion rates, time-spent-per-day, and score timelines. Accurate completion rates traverse the full course/topic/subtopic/material hierarchy.

tour.title: AI Recommendations & Analytics
tour.description: The AI recommendation service fetches student progress, enriches ID references with actual names from Firebase ID mappings, then sends a structured prompt to Gemini for personalized learning suggestions. The analytics endpoint provides performance breakdowns and improvement roadmaps.

tour.title: Teacher & Admin Panels
tour.description: Teachers have CRUD for courses/topics/materials, live class scheduling (Zoom), exam creation with quiz/subjective questions, student progress views with accurate analytics, and profile management. Admins manage teachers (add/remove/update), view comprehensive analytics dashboards with class distribution and subject summaries.

tour.title: Flutter Frontend Architecture
tour.description: The Flutter app uses Provider for state management with MultiProvider at root. Firebase initialized on startup with platform-specific options. The app supports 6 languages (en, hi, es, fr, zh, de) via flutter_localizations. Navigation is role-based (student/teacher/admin) through BottomNav. Key screens include Home (courses, progress, banner), ASKMe AI chat, profile, progress analytics, and teacher/admin panels.

tour.title: ASKMe AI Chat (Frontend)
tour.description: The ASKMe screen provides a full chatbot interface where students can ask questions via text, upload images/audio/video/documents, select response language, and receive AI-generated answers. Chat history is persisted locally. The controller manages file attachments, language selection, and all API calls to backend multimodal endpoints.
